item.title: GVRD ramps up youth roundtable to enact city change
item.description: On the fourth Friday of each month, a handful of Vallejo’s forward-thinking youth meet to discuss solutions to the city’s most pressing issues. item.description: Following a week-long statewide crackdown on human trafficking, state law enforcement officials, including in Solano County, announced this week that more than 600 arrests were made and 170 people rescued, including children as young as 13. item.description: Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey, along with mayors from all over the Bay Area and the country, exchanged information on topics including successful practices regarding Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) enforcement in the nation’s cities at the Jan. 28-30 conference.
